newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strasbourg air cargo up 8.8pct between Jan-Nov 96.
newsitem.headline: Strasbourg air cargo up 8.8pct between Jan-Nov 96.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Strasbourg-Entzheim airport in the first 11 months of 1996 totalled 6,104 tonnes, up 8.8 percent on the same period the previous year, airport authority figures show.

Air Jet, airline subsidiary of French express distribution company, Jet Services, operates a nightly air cargo service between Strasbourg and Paris/CDG with British Aerospace BAe 146QC (quick-change) aircraft.
The Alsace airport also features on Air Jet's Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille-Paris/CDG itinerary.
Postal traffic handled at Strasbourg totalled 4,652 tonnes, a decrease of 2.4 percent on 1995 levels.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Strasbourg on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft.
